newsitem.title: USA: Feinberg group holds 5.6 pct Holmes stake.
newsitem.headline: Feinberg group holds 5.6 pct Holmes stake.

text.p: A group led by New York investment adviser Stephen Feinberg said Wednesday it has acquired a 5.6 percent stake in Holmes Protection Group Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 324,600 common shares of Holmes on September 25 at prices ranging from $11.00 to $11.46 a share.
The group said it holds the stgaker for investment purposes for private investment funds, including Cerberus International Ltd and Ultra Cerberus Fund Ltd.
